children: FTAI Aviation said its board approved a stock buyback program for up to $500 million.
The company said the share repurchase authorization, which extends through Sept. 30, 2029, will be funded using cash on its balance sheet.
Shares rose 3.7% to $182.99 in after-hours trading on Tuesday.
